decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis app is closely tied to the core software, is prominently promoted as a new product line, and the growing firm has enough slack to carry it, so performance likely meets aspirations.

The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training resources and supports customer loyalty; a growing firm with slack has little reason to start problemistic search and drop it.
Remote screen-sharing support is a low-cost, efficiency-improving complement to the firm's support services that likely meets aspirations, so it would be retained.
